score_method: Rounded category means across all four actual images; every output retained and none regenerated or omitted.

outputs.name: Diamond-cut main ring
evidence: 24-part micro-cadence is visibly tied to real lens retention
original offset horizontal court avoids the prior copied combination
graphite/bronze CMF is mature and restrained
outputs.limitation: The ring remains the most symbol-adjacent carrier and must stay process-scale in future use.

outputs.name: Knurled power key
evidence: functional control carries the cultural cadence
two-camera topology remains quiet and credible
outputs.limitation: The circular key is oversized and visually reads as a secondary hardware object rather than a fully integrated control.

outputs.name: Photo-etched bridge edge
evidence: micro-cuts form a restrained continuous functional cadence
three-lens bridge has clear hierarchy and distinct frame-fed relation
outputs.limitation: The top-left frame transition appears slightly stepped and needs cleaner whole-body continuity.

outputs.name: Acoustic grille cadence
evidence: lower-frame perforation cadence is clearly visible and functional
two views share coherent low elevation and matching underside geometry
outputs.limitation: Floating composition and broad underside emphasis make the image less conventional as a primary marketing hero.

schema_learning: Combination-level originality prevents the prior copied-camera failure without banning common primitives. Exact-count cadence works when implemented as process-scale detail on a real lens ring, bridge edge or acoustic grille. Functional micro-cadence is more robust than symbolic surface graphics. Keep the originality combination check and bounded-carrier rule; avoid oversized control carriers.
